function: Joint antenna selection (CNN) and precoding design (GNN) at each AP to maximize downlink sum spectral efficiency (p. 2).
system: Downlink cell-free MIMO, 3 APs with 8 antennas (5 active), 4 single-antenna users, TDD, no RIS, 20 MHz bandwidth, no carrier frequency stated (p. 8, Table I).
method: GNN precoder trained unsupervised with sum-SE loss; CNN antenna-selection classifier trained supervised with labels from iterative search; centralized offline training, distributed online inference (p. 4, 7).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rayleigh small-scale fading, log-distance path loss (exponent 3.67), random user positions, LMMSE-estimated CSI; synthetic training and test data from the same model (p. 2, 8).
test_conditions: Same simulated setup for training and testing (3 APs, 4 users, 8 antennas, 5 active); 1000 test realizations; sweeps over K, power, M, N, I (p. 8-11).
baselines: Non-learned: centralized MMSE (with iterative search), distributed MMSE, MRT. Learned: CNN- and MLP-based precoders, GNN- and MLP-based antenna selection (p. 9).
metrics: Sum spectral efficiency (bit/s/Hz), computational time (ms) and information exchange (complex scalars) (p. 11, Table II p. 12).
complexity: Measured computational time averaged over 1000 realizations: 0.76 ms for GNN + CNN versus 227.6 ms for centralized MMSE + IS, on a laptop CPU (p. 11-12).
openness: None; no code or data link given, data are simulated (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 2: "follow Rayleigh distribution" - custom simulator with Rayleigh fading and a log-distance path loss (p. 8); no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is stated.
q2_support: p. 8: "Transfer learning can be used" - only a statement; no model is tested on a scenario, configuration or dataset unseen in training, and Figs. 12-16 (p. 10-11) sweep K, power, M, N and I without stating that models are reused or adapted.
q3_support: p. 9: "GNN-based algorithm outperforms the two baseline algorithms" - CNN- and MLP-based precoders, in sum spectral efficiency; p. 10: "the proposed GNN + CNN scheme significantly outperforms the" distributed MMSE and MRT (non-learned), in sum spectral efficiency.
q4_support: p. 11: "we present the sum spectral efficiency, computational time, and information exchange" - Table II (p. 12) gives measured computational time: 0.76 ms for GNN + CNN, 227.6 ms for centralized MMSE + IS.
q5_support: p. 8: "The default simulation parameters" - data are simulated with a custom model (Table I); no code or data link or DOI and no public dataset is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included, area 3: antenna selection is learned jointly with the precoder to maximize sum SE, so it is treated as part of the precoder design and not as antenna hardware design. A RIS (IRS) appears only in the related work (p. 1-2). The PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint in the IEEE journal template; it prints no DOI, so the match with the DOI could not be checked from the text.
